title: The Border of Geneva Again
author: Edmund Yarrow
blurb: Sebastian Whitlock, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
